```tok
tok 1.0 "GO-MSP Measurement Process"

pool org "Organisation"
  lane GO "GO"
    start s0 "Start"
    task t_req "Request measurements"
    # end events will be placed later
  lane MSP "MSP"
    task t_check "Check received request"
    xor gx1 "Request denied?"
    task t_inform_fail1 "Inform GO about failure of reading"
    task t_measure "Perform measurement"
    xor gx2 "Measurement failure?"
    task t_inform_fail2 "Inform GO about failure of reading"
    task t_transmit "Transmit measured values"
  lane GO "GO"
    task t_process "Process measured values"
    task t_send_changed "Send changed values to MSP"
    task t_transmit_sp "Transmit readings to SP"
    end e_success "End"
  lane SP "SP"
    # No activities, only receive the transmission; end is in GO lane

# Sequence flows
flow s0 -> t_req -> t_check
flow t_check -> gx1
flow gx1 -> t_inform_fail1 "yes"
flow gx1 -> t_measure "no"
flow t_inform_fail1 -> e_success

flow t_measure -> gx2
flow gx2 -> t_inform_fail2 "yes"
flow gx2 -> t_transmit "no"
flow t_inform_fail2 -> e_success

flow t_transmit -> t_process
flow t_process -> t_send_changed
flow t_send_changed -> t_transmit_sp
flow t_transmit_sp -> e_success
```
